name: silvershop/personalisation
description: Per-product personalisation for SilverShop: engraving, monogram or "name on it" fields captured on the product page and attached to the individual order line, so two of the same product with different text are separate lines the maker sees when packing.

suggest.silvershop/invoicing: Carries the personalisation onto the invoice / packing-slip line so the maker sees it on the printed document.
suggest.silvershop/order-admin: Groups the order screen so the personalised line reads cleanly when packing.
suggest.silvershop/product-bundles: Personalisation composes with bundle lines (needs the core add-to-cart data hook).
suggest.silvershop/storefront: Themed product page + cart line summary styling for the personalisation fields.
